description: This file defines the JsonBody class, a model representing JSON content with associated metadata, used within the mockserver project for handling JSON request/response bodies.

classes.name: JsonBody
classes.description: Represents a JSON body with content, match type, and content type, providing methods for JSON parsing and object creation.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Static factory methods to create JsonBody instances from JSON strings or objects with optional match type, charset, and content type.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific JSON field as a JsonNode.

methods.name: getRawBytes
methods.description: Returns the raw byte array of the JSON content.

methods.name: getMatchType
methods.description: Returns the match type used for this JSON body.
